# 2. read in campaigns data for NYC, other variable, save dataset
```{r}
# Upper 2021-07-24
nyc_boundary <- sf::read_sf('~/phenology-urban/data/raw/NY/boundary/nybb_dissolved.shp')
nyc_boundary <- st_transform(nyc_boundary, crs = 4326)

Upper_point_af <- sf::read_sf('~/phenology-urban/data/raw/NY/Heat_Map_Camp/bronx-man/af_trav.shp') %>%
  mutate(datetime = as.POSIXct(datetime, format = "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"))
upper_ndvi <- read_stars("C:/Users/Jiali/Downloads/upper_nyc_20210724.tif")
upper_af_ndvi <- terra::extract(upper_ndvi, Upper_point_af)
Upper_point_af <- cbind(Upper_point_af, setNames(list(upper_af_ndvi[,2]), "ndvi"))%>%
  mutate(temp_c = (temp_f - 32) * 5 / 9)

# Lower Brooklyn 2022-07-30
Lower_point_af <- sf::read_sf('~/phenology-urban/data/raw/NY/Heat_Map_Camp/brooklyn/af_trav.shp') %>%
  mutate(datetime = as.POSIXct("2022-07-20 15:30:00", format="%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")) %>%
  mutate(trav_id = "af")
lower_ndvi <- read_stars("C:/Users/Jiali/Downloads/lower_nyc_20210730.tif")
lower_af_ndvi <- terra::extract(lower_ndvi, Lower_point_af)
Lower_point_af <- cbind(Lower_point_af, setNames(list(lower_af_ndvi[,2]), "ndvi"))%>%
  mutate(temp_c = (temp_f - 32) * 5 / 9)

# set the buffer, compute the surrounding ndvi_avg
window_size <- 11
focal_ndvi <- focal(upper_ndvi, w = matrix(1, window_size, window_size), fun = mean, na.rm = TRUE)
ndvi_means <- terra::extract(focal_ndvi, Upper_point_af)
Upper_point_af <- cbind(Upper_point_af, setNames(list(ndvi_means[,2]), paste0("ndvi_", window_size)))
focal_ndvi <- focal(lower_ndvi, w = matrix(1, window_size, window_size), fun = mean, na.rm = TRUE)
ndvi_means <- terra::extract(focal_ndvi, Lower_point_af)
Lower_point_af <- cbind(Lower_point_af, setNames(list(ndvi_means[,2]), paste0("ndvi_", window_size)))


# macro-climate
# for upper 2021-07-24

# daily extreme
up_daily_tmax <- terra::rast("~/phenology-urban/data/raw/NY/Daymet/tmax_daily_2021_ncss.nc")
nycboun_reproj <- sf::st_transform(nyc_boundary, crs = sf::st_crs(terra::crs(up_daily_tmax,proj = T)))
up_daily_tmax <- terra::project(terra::mask (terra::crop(up_daily_tmax, terra::ext(nycboun_reproj)),
                                    nycboun_reproj), terra::crs(nyc_boundary))
up_daily_tmax_sp <- up_daily_tmax[[yday("2021-07-24")]]
writeRaster(up_daily_tmax_sp, filename = "data/proc/daymet/nyc/tmax_daily_upper.tif")


# summer average
tmax.nc <- terra::rast("~/phenology-urban/data/raw/NY/Daymet/tmax_monavg_2021_ncss.nc")
tmin.nc <- terra::rast("~/phenology-urban/data/raw/NY/Daymet/tmin_monavg_2021_ncss.nc")
nycboun_reproj <- sf::st_transform(nyc_boundary, crs = sf::st_crs(terra::crs(tmax.nc,proj = T)))
tmax <- terra::project(terra::mask (terra::crop(tmax.nc, terra::ext(nycboun_reproj)),
```

# 4. Try causal inference method - only local

NCLD-2021
  21-24 developed, open, low - high density
  41 deciduous forest, 42, evergreen
  52 shrub
  71 grass
  81 pasture

## 4.1. Classic correlation/regression
```{r}
filtered_data <- all_nyc %>% filter(lc_ncld != "0") %>%
  na.omit() %>%
  filter(location == "lower")

# Classic correlation/regression - only local
olsreg <- lm(temp_c ~ ndvi +daymet_tavg_summer + daymet_tmax_daily + lc_ncld, data = filtered_data) 
#               
vif(olsreg)
summary_olsreg <- summary(olsreg)
coefficients <- summary_olsreg$coefficients
coefficients_df <- as.data.frame(coefficients)
coefficients_df$Term <- rownames(coefficients_df)
names(coefficients_df) <- c("Estimate", "Std.Error", "t.value", "p.value", "Term")
coefficients_df <- coefficients_df[!(coefficients_df$Term %in% c("(Intercept)")), ]
coefficients_df$Significance <- cut(coefficients_df$p.value,
                                    breaks = c(-Inf, 0.001, 0.01, 0.05, 0.1, Inf),
                                    labels = c("***", "**", "*", ".", ""))

plot <- ggplot(coefficients_df, aes(x = Term, y = Estimate)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", aes(fill = Significance), width = 0.7) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = Estimate - Std.Error, ymax = Estimate + Std.Error), width = 0.2) +
  geom_text(aes(label = round(Estimate, 2), y = ifelse(Estimate > 0,
                                                       (Estimate + sign(Estimate) * Std.Error +0.3),
                (Estimate + sign(Estimate) * Std.Error - 0.3))), size = 4) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("***"="goldenrod1","**"="goldenrod1", "*" = "goldenrod1")) +
  labs(title = "Coefficients of the Linear Model",
       x = "Variable",
       y = "Estimate of coefficient",
       fill = "Significance") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text = element_text(size = 12),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 14),
        plot.title = element_text(size = 16),
        legend.position = "none")
print(plot)
```

## 4.2. Partial correlation
```{r}
# Partial correlation - only local
#function of temperature

#locate the row with NA

filtered_data_pca <-  filtered_data %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  subset(select= c("temp_c", "ndvi", "ndvi_11", "ndvi_31", "ndvi_51", "daymet_tmax_daily", "daymet_tavg_summer")) %>%
  na.omit()

pcor_result <- cor(filtered_data_pca)
partial_correlations <- pcor_result$estimate["temp_c", ]
partial_correlations <- partial_correlations[-1]

p_values <- pcor_result$p.value["temp_c", ]
p_values <- p_values[-1]

plot_data <- data.frame(
  Variable = names(partial_correlations),
  PartialCorrelation = partial_correlations,
  Significance = p_values
)

plot_data$SignificanceLabel <- ifelse(plot_data$Significance < 0.01, "**",
                                      ifelse(plot_data$Significance < 0.05, "*",
                                             ifelse(plot_data$Significance < 0.1, "^", "")))

plot <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = Variable, y = PartialCorrelation)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", aes(fill = SignificanceLabel) ) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("goldenrod1", "grey"))+
  geom_text(aes(x = Variable, y = ifelse(PartialCorrelation > 0,(PartialCorrelation+0.03),(PartialCorrelation - 0.03)),
            label = round(PartialCorrelation, 2)), color = "black", size = 4) +
  labs(x = "", y = "Partial Correlation") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(legend.position = "none") +
  theme(
  legend.position = "none",
  axis.text = element_text(size = 14),
  axis.title = element_text(size = 14),
  plot.title = element_text(size = 16)
)



correlations <- cor(filtered_data_pca, use = "complete.obs")[, "temp_c"]
correlations <- correlations[-1]

# 计算p值
n <- nrow(filtered_data_pca)
t_values <- correlations / sqrt((1 - correlations^2) / (n - 2))
p_values <- 2 * pt(-abs(t_values), df = n - 2)

# 准备数据进行绘图
plot_data <- data.frame(
  Variable = names(correlations),
  Correlation = correlations,
  P_value = p_values
)

plot_data$SignificanceLabel <- ifelse(plot_data$P_value < 0.01, "**",
                                      ifelse(plot_data$P_value < 0.05, "*",
                                             ifelse(plot_data$P_value < 0.1, "^", "")))

# 绘图
plot <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = Variable, y = Correlation)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", aes(fill = SignificanceLabel), width = 0.7) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("**" = "goldenrod1", "*" = "goldenrod1")) +
  geom_text(aes(x = Variable, y = ifelse(Correlation > 0, (Correlation + 0.03), (Correlation - 0.03)),
                label = round(Correlation, 2)), color = "black", size = 4) +
  labs(x = "", y = "Correlation") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    axis.text = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 14),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 16)
  )

# 显示图形
print(plot)
```

## 4.3. Propensity score matching - local
```{r}
data <- filtered_data %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  subset(select= c("temp_c", "ndvi", "daymet_tmax_daily","daymet_tavg_summer", "lc_ncld", "tcc_nlcd")) %>%
  mutate(ndvi_bi = case_when(
    ndvi < 0.2 ~ 0,
    ndvi >= 0.2 ~ 1))

# Get binary

matching <- matchit(ndvi_bi ~ lc_ncld + daymet_tmax_daily , method = "optimal", data = data, 
                    distance = "glm", link = "probit", discard = "both", ratio = 1)
summary(matching$model)[[12]]
pscore_data_matched = match.data(matching) 
head(arrange(pscore_data_matched, subclass))
summary(matching)

t.test(subset(data, ndvi_bi == 1)$temp_c, subset(data, ndvi_bi == 0)$temp_c)
t.test(subset(pscore_data_matched, ndvi_bi == 1)$temp_c, subset(pscore_data_matched, ndvi_bi == 0)$temp_c) 


# use dummy  same result
data_with_dummies <- model.matrix(~ lc_ncld + daymet_tmax_daily + daymet_tavg_summer + ndvi_bi, data) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  bind_cols(data %>% dplyr::select(temp_c, ndvi)) %>%
  dplyr::select(-`(Intercept)`)%>%
  dplyr::select(-`lc_ncld0`)

matching <- matchit(ndvi_bi ~ lc_ncld22 + lc_ncld23 + lc_ncld24 + lc_ncld41 + lc_ncld42 +
                      lc_ncld52 + lc_ncld71 + lc_ncld81 + daymet_tmax_daily, 
                    method = "nearest", data = data_with_dummies, 
                    distance = "glm", link = "probit", discard = "both")
summary(matching$model)[[12]]
pscore_data_matched = match.data(matching) 
head(arrange(pscore_data_matched, subclass))
summary(matching)

t.test(subset(data, ndvi_bi == 1)$temp_c, subset(data, ndvi_bi == 0)$temp_c)
t.test(subset(pscore_data_matched, ndvi_bi == 1)$temp_c, subset(pscore_data_matched, ndvi_bi == 0)$temp_c) 

# add tcc
matching <- matchit(ndvi_bi ~ lc_ncld + daymet_tmax_daily + daymet_tavg_summer + tcc_nlcd, method = "nearest", data = data, 
                    distance = "glm", link = "probit", discard = "both")
summary(matching$model)[[12]]
pscore_data_matched = match.data(matching) 
head(arrange(pscore_data_matched, subclass))
summary(matching)

t.test(subset(data, ndvi_bi == 1)$temp_c, subset(data, ndvi_bi == 0)$temp_c)
t.test(subset(pscore_data_matched, ndvi_bi == 1)$temp_c, subset(pscore_data_matched, ndvi_bi == 0)$temp_c) 


# Continuous
# Subseting the data
set.seed(123)
sampled_data <- data %>%
  sample_n(4000)

# Propensity score
ps_model <- ps(
  formula = ndvi ~ .,
  data = sampled_data,
  estimand = "ATE",
  n.trees = 3000,
  interaction.depth = 3,
  shrinkage = 0.01,
  perm.test.iters = 0,
  stop.method = "ks.max",
  verbose = FALSE
)
sampled_data$weights <- ps_model$w

effect_model <- lm(temp_c ~ ndvi, data = sampled_data, weights = weights)
summary(effect_model)

ggplot(data_with_dummies, aes(x = ndvi, y = temp_c)) +
  geom_point(aes(weight = weights), alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", aes(weight = weights), color = "blue") +
  labs(title = "Relationship between NDVI and Temperature", x = "NDVI", y = "Temperature (°C)") +
  theme_minimal()
```

## 4.4. SEM - only local
```{r}
data <- filtered_data %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  subset(select= c("temp_c", "ndvi", "daymet_tmax_daily","lc_ncld"))

data_with_dummies <- model.matrix(~ lc_ncld + daymet_tmax_daily, data) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  bind_cols(data %>% dplyr::select(temp_c, ndvi)) %>%
  dplyr::select(-`(Intercept)`)%>%
  dplyr::select(-`lc_ncld0`)

sem_model <- '
  temp_c ~ ndvi + daymet_tmax_daily + lc_ncld
  ndvi ~ lc_ncld22 + lc_ncld23 + lc_ncld24 + lc_ncld41 + lc_ncld42 + lc_ncld52 + lc_ncld71 + lc_ncld81
  daymet_tmax_daily ~ lc_ncld22 + lc_ncld23 + lc_ncld24 + lc_ncld41 + lc_ncld42 + lc_ncld52 + lc_ncld71 + lc_ncld81
'

fit <- sem(sem_model, data = data_with_dummies)
summary(fit, standardized = TRUE)
semPaths(fit, "std", layout = "tree", edge.label.cex = 1.2, sizeMan = 5, sizeLat = 6)


```
